To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
CEOs’ reputation is mainly based on the ability perspective and that the most important activity to develop their reputation is the one related to the management of the company.

(1) the symbolic image perspective underlies the development and maintenance of CEOs’ reputation, more than the ability perspective; (2) CEOs are aware that the activities that can contribute to the development of their reputation are: (a) the communication of their personal values, (b) the communication of the values that guide their leadership style, and (c) the communication of results obtained in the past; (3) CEOs are aware of the influence of their personal reputations on the corporate reputation

CEOs are more inclined to develop their reputation through actions than through image; CEOs are more inclined toward ability perspective; the CEOs consider their personal reputation to be influential in creating the reputation of the company.
In summary, our research is concerned with

three main aspects: (1) the development of the CEO reputation, (2) the activities that contribute most to the development of a CEO good name and (3) the influence of CEO reputation on corporate reputation.

two main objectives: (1) to explore the theoretical perspectives (ability or symbolic-image) that underlie the development of CEOs’ reputation, and (2) to explore the activities that contribute the most in building a leader’s good name.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

(i) CEOs’ reputation is mainly based on the ability to perform their job and to achieve the corporate goals, (ii) the activities that contribute most to create a leader’s reputation are those that can be considered as “symbolic”, (iii) CEOs consider the level of influence that their reputation has on the corporate reputation quite high.
the reputation of CEOs is a complex and multi-faceted phenomenon that can be explained through the combination of both the ability and the symbolic image perspectives.

1) the ability perspective prevails on the symbolic image perspective; 2) the CEO reputation is mainly built through the CEO’s own actions and the actions of the organization; 3) the CEO reputation influences the corporate reputation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the CEOs’ personal reputation has an important influence on their corporate reputation, and that the symbolic image perspective is the main driver in the process of reputation development.
the CEOs’ personal reputation is a relevant factor in determining corporate reputation.

the ability perspective prevails in the development of CEO reputation; CEOs are aware that the reputation of the leader is an important element of the corporate reputation and that it is possible to influence the reputation of the company through the reputation of the CEO.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ability perspective is the main theoretical framework underlying the development of CEOs reputation.
CEOs believe that they have a high influence on corporate reputation, but their reputation is mainly based on their symbolic image.
the CEOs’ personal reputation has a significant effect on the corporate one, and that this is more relevant in the case of CEOs that are more able to communicate the value of the company.
